cases.title: Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo
cases.holding: Courts decide statutory questions independently; Chevron is overruled.
cases.whyItMatters: Removes the deference step from every agency-authority argument.
cases.notes: Overrules Chevron. APA section 706 does the work. Watch the stare decisis carve-out at 412.

quotes.text: Courts must exercise their independent judgment in deciding whether an agency has acted within its statutory authority.

workspaceSections.notes: Open with Loper Bright, then the statutory text.

documentSections.label: (a)
documentSections.text: To the extent necessary to decision and when presented, the reviewing court shall decide all relevant questions of law, interpret constitutional and statutory provisions, and determine the meaning or applicability of the terms of an agency action.

documentSections.label: (2)(A)
documentSections.text: The reviewing court shall hold unlawful and set aside agency action, findings, and conclusions found to be arbitrary, capricious, an abuse of discretion, or otherwise not in accordance with law.
